summary: Short kerb on a busy arterial at a junction, no parking.

best_section.where: East kerb of Clarence Road, just south of the first junction

drivers.seclusion: Houses 12 m away behind a tree strip; more homes and apartments across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs against the lane with hatched markings and a junction by 25 m; no clear pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane through road with turning lanes and an island; heavy traffic.
drivers.convention: A couple of cars sit near the start only; the stretch itself is not a parking kerb.

sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the east verge; shaded much of the day.
